payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each string, keep a set of all substrings up to length 20, plus a 20-char prefix and suffix. On merge, compute cross-substrings from suffix of first and prefix of second, union sets, and find largest k where set size equals 2^k.
payload.rationale: The solution processes operations sequentially, building a state for each concatenated string from the states of its components. This iterative state combination is a form of dynamic programming with a one-dimensional state (per string), efficiently avoiding full string storage.
